name: aladdin.radii
description: Canonical corner-radius scale. Gently rounded, chamfer-adjacent — never soft/pill-heavy except seals and tags.
maintenance: Manually maintained. Edit here first, then DESIGN.md frontmatter (rounded) and frontend/tailwind.config.ts (theme.extend.borderRadius).

pill.usage: Verification seals and status pills only.

rules.border-weight: Borders are 1px hairlines; a colored border heavier than 1px is not part of the language.
